  let stack = []
  let i = 0
  while i < to_num(list_len(tokens)) do
    let tok = tokens[i]
    if (tok == "+") or (tok == "-") or (tok == "*") then
      let n = to_num(list_len(stack))
      let b = stack[n - 1]
      let a = stack[n - 2]
      let stack = list_set(stack, n - 2, 0)
      let new_stack = []
      let j = 0
      while j < n - 2 do
        let new_stack = list_push(new_stack, stack[j])
        let j = j + 1
      end
      let value = 0
      if tok == "+" then
        let value = a + b
      end
      if tok == "-" then
        let value = a - b
      end
      if tok == "*" then
        let value = a * b
      end
      let stack = list_push(new_stack, value)
    else
      let stack = list_push(stack, to_num(tok))
    end
    let i = i + 1
  end
  return stack[0]
end
